original_test_intent: Stress the owner-designated disposable HGX SSD/volume with the approved NVQual Test #18 workload and prove required performance, error-free completion, media/filesystem health and host stability without hang or reboot.
original_method: Bind an expendable target by stable hardware and storage-stack identity; prove it is not OS/boot/EFI/swap/mounted production/LVM/RAID metadata or unknown shared storage; pin Test #18/fio job, access scope, pattern, block size, depth, workers, duration and thresholds; preserve health/log baselines; monitor complete metrics/errors/temperature and stop on first safety or health fault; restore only through the approved plan.
manual_activity: Owner designates the expendable target, approves data loss, workload, thresholds and recovery; an operator verifies physical/logical identity and supervises isolation/re-provisioning.
required_inputs: Written proof target is expendable and explicit data-loss approval
Pinned NVQual Test #18 or fio job with read/write scope, block size, depth, workers, size, duration, direct I/O and preconditioning
Performance/error/health/thermal/endurance limits, maintenance window, aborts, backup/re-provision and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Never guess a storage target; reject OS, boot, EFI, swap, LVM/RAID metadata, mounted production and unknown devices
Re-resolve stable identity immediately before execution and inhibit on any mapping change
Preserve logs and SMART/NVMe health before writes
Stop on wrong-target evidence, media/filesystem error, unsafe temperature/power, capacity exhaustion, host instability, hang/reboot, tool failure or evidence gap
No automatic retry or unapproved repair
agent_execution_scope: Perform read-only identity/storage-stack/health validation and compare to signed target authorization
Run only the exact approved Test #18/fio job after confirmation
Collect complete fio/NVQual metrics, errors, health, temperature and platform logs
Stop/isolate on first fault; do not choose targets, repair/reformat, retry or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expendable target, data loss, exact workload, runtime and thresholds
Confirm storage exclusions, monitoring, maintenance and recovery/re-provision plan
Review performance/health evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its fio direction is plausible but no command may be formed until target and job are owner-supplied; BW/IOPS alone also omit latency, errors, health, thermal and storage-stack safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned Test #18/fio job against the signed stable-identity disposable target, with an identity interlock immediately before launch and complete machine-readable output plus health/log monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #18, SSD stress, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/60-minute allocation remain; missing target and workload parameters are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH DESTRUCTIVE STORAGE STRESS WITH TARGET IDENTITY INTERLOCK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed target manifest binding hardware and storage-stack identity to the exact workload and recovery plan; revalidate it at launch and collect synchronized performance, media, filesystem, thermal and platform evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds non-negotiable target exclusions, stable identity, explicit data-loss gate, complete job/acceptance contract, health monitoring, abort and re-provision recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful fio summary cannot prove correct target, NVQual #18 coverage, retained data safety, device health or absence of latent errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sustained/destructive I/O can erase data, consume endurance, overheat the device, fill a filesystem or destabilize the host.

project_override_considerations: A file-backed non-destructive job is not equivalent to whole-device destructive coverage unless the owner accepts the difference. Device path names alone are never identity. Missing target/package is readiness pending, not DUT failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, signed target authorization and explicit data-loss approval
Stable serial/WWN/namespace/storage-stack map and exclusion proof
Pinned Test #18/fio job/configuration hash and approved performance/health limits
Complete raw BW/IOPS/latency/error/runtime output and workload completion accounting
Pre/during/post SMART/NVMe health, media counters, temperature, filesystem/capacity, dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL evidence
Abort/isolation/re-provision or clean final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #18 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target SSD stress. Missing target, job and thresholds are critical readiness inputs, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The storage-stress purpose is clear. A safe disposable target, workload and acceptance can be supplied, so static review is complete and execution remains approval-gated rather than permanently BLOCKED.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2137 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00014-V002: approve the exact disposable target by serial/WWN/namespace/storage-stack identity with data-loss authorization and OS/boot/EFI/swap/LVM/RAID/dm/mounted-production exclusions, pinned NVQual Test #18/fio profile, pattern/blocksize/depth/workers/size/duration/direct-I/O rules, performance/error/health/thermal limits, aborts, and re-provision recovery.

review_improvement: Makes destructive target identity and data-loss authorization the primary interlock and expands acceptance from BW/IOPS to complete latency/error/device/filesystem/platform health.
independent_technical_reasoning: Storage device paths are mutable and can point to a different namespace after reboot or enumeration changes. Destructive safety therefore depends on stable hardware identity plus the full stacking/mount map immediately before launch. Performance without media, filesystem and thermal health is incomplete, and rerunning after an anomaly may destroy causal evidence or more data, so first-fault stop and explicit recovery are mandatory.
